rawContent: How can someone be “personally victimized” by what someone else is wearing?! Quote of someone referring to what a celebrity wore to a funeral. Please, don’t use this phrase to describe this nonsense, people are REAL #victims #trauma #CSA #survivor #metoo #advocate 🙏❤️✊

#trauma motivated my beh as an adolescent. I felt #sex was all my worth & was completely #fragmented. I allowed these men to fuck me & lost my virginity (than I’m aware of) at 11.  This is why #slutshaming must stop. Rarely are young girls #promiscuous b/c they love sex. #metoo

As women, we are beginning to fight the injustices experienced by the #trauma of #victimblaming, #rapeculture & people not being held accountable. We will continue to #StandUP & fight until we prevail ✊🙏❤️ #metoo #socialjustice #ibelievevictims #Warriors #mytribe #recovery
